card.name: Everyday physical objects as nouns
card.fires_on: Concrete everyday object nouns, often plural, such as stockings, toys, laptops, flute, or hat. Also fires partway through words like boomerangs and wands, in general non-medical prose.

modes.label: Plural object nouns
modes.description: A plural household or personal item noun that ends a noun phrase.
modes.example: Encrypt confidential data on<< laptops>> and in databases.

modes.label: Partway through object words
modes.description: Inside or at the end of a longer object word split into pieces.
modes.example: King Tut possessed a few boomer<<angs>>, some plated in gold

modes.label: Modifier before an item
modes.description: A descriptive word right before a noun for clothing or items.
modes.example: coats and a<< round>> blue hat as a work uniform.

card.plain: It lights up on names of ordinary physical things like toys, laptops or stockings in everyday text.
